desc: Build brute-force checker for N≤10 (exhaustive round assignments or BFS) to serve as ground truth
Run tester; validate model (ops = rounds + inversions) and the interval-completeness hypothesis; collect counterexamples if any
Validate/fix prefix DP recurrence against brute force (iterate until dp_mismatch=0 on all small cases)
Implement three-level exact/quadratic/fast versions of the validated recurrence with differential harness
Run harness; confirm mismatches=0 everywhere, samples 3/4/8, edge cases correct, and measure alternating N=2000 timing
If fast_solve is too slow or mismatches: replace per-pair F(tuple(inner)) with per-value incremental filtered DP (BIT/segment tree over same-value predecessors inside B_v) to get true O(N log N)
Final implementation: fast I/O for T up to 1e5, sum N ≤ 2e5; per-test reset clearing only touched values; verify samples and edge cases
